Small south background swell (Waikīkī model about 1–1.3 ft at 14–16 s; NWS south-facing 1–3 ft on exposed shores) with breezy E trades: NWS Honolulu Metro E 10–20 mph rising to 20–25 mph in the afternoon. beginner.recommendation: Plan for an early, short session. Trades stay breezy tomorrow and are forecast to be stronger than today by afternoon (NWS Honolulu Metro: E 10–20 mph, increasing to 20–25 mph in the afternoon); at 5:53 PM tonight Honolulu airport was ENE 17 mph gusting 29. The first two hours after sunrise are the lightest-wind part of the day. Surf at Canoes should stay small (no Canoes-specific forecast for Tuesday read; the Waikīkī model has about 1–1.3 ft at 14–16 s), but small long-period sets still push inside, so watch several full set cycles before committing. Showers stay mostly windward and mauka (NWS) and the Honolulu Metro forecast carries no rain chance for Tuesday, but check water color anyway: the DOH list was not read. One student or a small group of strong adults early; several students or children only if drift is low. Your on-site read overrides this report.
